author: blu
body: The Audio effect is the right to make the machine emit sound. It is a bare marker here, the way Microphone and Display are: the operations that use it are not declared here.

author: blu
body: Declaring the operations here anyway is the mistake this chapter exists to avoid, and it has been made before: Microphone once declared listen and is-quiet with no handler anywhere in the tree, so a call type-checked clean and died at emit with CDX2040. A marker that promises nothing keeps that promise.
